name: BillDogSuperwallIntegration
summary: Superwall paywalls, BillDog purchases: a SuperwallKit 4.x PurchaseController backed by BillDog.
description:
SuperwallBillDogPurchaseController lets Superwall present paywalls while
BillDog buys, restores, validates receipts and owns entitlements. It keeps
Superwall's subscription status in sync with BillDog's active entitlements,
identifies Superwall's user as BillDog's, forwards Superwall analytics events
and starts BillDog web checkout from a Superwall custom action.
